name: Feature request

labels: ["enhancement"]

## The problem

What is annoying, missing, or unsafe in the scaffold today? Be concrete.

## The proposal

What would you add or change? Which build-order layer does it belong in
(Map / AGENTS / Rules / Skills / MCP / Hooks / Sub-agents)?

## Why this belongs in the starter

This repo deliberately stays small. New entries should:

- apply to most repositories, not one team's stack;
- not require any vendor or organization name;
- be the smallest correct addition;
- not duplicate something already covered by an existing layer.

Make the case here.

## Alternatives considered

What did you try first that did not work?
